title: Writing and Running Your First Lua Program
subtopics: Printing output and executing a script
learning_outcomes: Create and save a Lua source file.
Run the script in a Lua 5.5 interpreter or interactive prompt.
Compare observed output with an expected result.

content.intro: Lua is a compact, dynamically typed language designed to be embedded in host applications as well as run by its interpreter. Its small core makes it useful for extending software, but a host may expose only a selected set of APIs.
content.why_it_matters: Lua is a compact, dynamically typed language designed to be embedded in host applications as well as run by its interpreter. items.title: Mistake 1
items.text: Confusing Writing and Running Your First Lua Program with a similarly named feature in another language or runtime. Fix: follow the version-matched reference and test the smallest example.

items.title: Mistake 2
items.text: Relying on an output order or environment capability that the language/host does not guarantee. Fix: document assumptions and make order/capabilities explicit.

items.title: Mistake 3
items.text: Skipping a boundary test or failing to check error-return values. Fix: test invalid and boundary inputs and inspect failure values.

content.task: Try it yourself: adapt the example to demonstrate “Writing and Running Your First Lua Program” with a different input or boundary case. Predict the result before running it, record what you observe, and explain one limitation.
task_acceptance_criteria: Explain the central behavior of Writing and Running Your First Lua Program in your own words.
Verify the result using a supported local runtime or clearly state why the host/tooling prevents a full run.
Identify a boundary case or compatibility/security limit relevant to the lesson.
hints: First identify the input, output, and any assumed runtime or host feature.
Reduce the problem to the smallest example that exposes the relevant rule.
Test one normal case and one boundary/failure case; inspect error output without leaking secrets.
